RFERP v2.1.0

== 中文 ==

本版把批次用料流程补完整：投料记录到入库批次、库存区分现有与在产占用、
追溯查询支持片段匹配，另有一批批次、零件、BOM 界面的改进。

一、批次投料

- 完成批次前，凡是要扣料的零件都必须先记录投料：逐个零件指定从哪些
  入库批次出料、各出多少；重复录入按零件整体覆盖，批次的排列顺序就是
  扣料顺序，未排到的余量按先进先出扣
- 用量由 BOM 公式或临时零件数量算出，界面只读、保留两位小数；分到某个
  批次的数量超过其可用库存时不允许保存
- 已完成批次的投料锁定，不能再改
- 新增「临时零件」：BOM 之外本批实际用到的料，总量按 BOM 公式推算，
  扣料与库存投影一并计入；跳过零件与临时零件在同一个对话框里管理，
  对话框中可看到各零件的现有与可用库存
- 跳过或移除零件时，自动清除它的投料记录并写入操作日志

二、库存投影

- 未完成批次按计划产量将消耗的料计入「在产占用」；零件库存给出三个数：
  现有 / 在产占用 / 可用，零件列表直接可见
- 零件详情能看到「把在产批次全部做完后还剩多少」，补货与排产看这个数
- 保存批次前可预览本批将预扣的料；完成批次因缺料被拒时，会指明库存
  被哪些批次占用
- 看板的缺料提醒拆分为「当前缺料」与「预计缺料」，并新增生产计划一览

三、双向追溯查询

- 查询方式扩为四种：产品批次号、产品名称/编码、零件编码/名称、零件批次号
- 全部支持片段匹配，只输一部分也能查，不必先找到完整编号
- 结果按批分组展示，命中的内容高亮
- 结果超过 500 条时提示仅显示前 500 条；查询为空时按原因给出不同提示

四、入库与盘点

- 每次入库自动生成入库批次并连续编号；零件详情页可查看出入库台账
- 入库单可填写备注；零件表单不再直接填库存数，库存一律由入库产生
- 零件详情按批次列库存，只列还有剩余的批次，已用完的批次收进折叠列表；
  支持逐批次盘点

五、BOM 管理

- BOM 明细按 产品 / 分类 / 零件 树状展示；行内可直接改数量、使用方式、
  损耗率与代用标记
- 切换产品时明细立即清空并记住所选产品；本屏不再提供建零件入口，
  零件统一在零件管理维护

六、其他

- 删除零件被拒时，会说明它被哪些生产记录引用，不再只报一个错误
- exe 文件属性里的版本号与程序版本保持一致
- 打开程序后数据库结构自动完成升级（升级前自动备份），无需手工操作

== English ==

This release completes the batch material workflow: feeding is recorded
against inbound batches, stock distinguishes on-hand from stock reserved
by in-progress batches, and trace queries accept partial input. It also
brings a round of improvements to the batch, part and BOM screens.

Batch feeding

- Completing a batch now requires feeding records for every part it
  deducts: pick the inbound batches to draw from and how much each.
  Re-recording a part overwrites its allocation, batch order is the
  deduction order, and anything not covered follows FIFO
- Usage is computed from the BOM formula or the temp-part quantity, shown
  read-only with two decimals; an allocation beyond a batch's available
  stock cannot be saved
- Feeding on completed batches is locked and can no longer be edited
- New "temp parts": material this batch actually uses but the BOM does not
  list. Totals are derived like a BOM line and count toward deductions and
  stock projection. Skipped parts and temp parts are managed in one dialog
  that also shows each part's on-hand and available stock
- Skipping or removing a part clears its feeding rows and writes an audit
  entry

Stock projection

- Stock that unfinished batches will consume (planned output by BOM) is
  reported as reserved; part stock now shows three numbers: on hand /
  reserved in production / available, visible right in the part list
- Part detail shows how much remains if all in-progress batches complete -
  the number to act on when restocking or planning
- Saving a batch can preview what it will reserve; when completion is
  refused for shortage, the batches holding the stock are named
- Dashboard alerts split into current shortages and projected shortages,
  plus a production plan overview

Two-way trace query

- Four query modes: product batch no., product name/code, part code/name,
  part batch no.
- All modes match partially, so a fragment is enough - no need for the
  full identifier
- Results are grouped by batch and matches are highlighted
- Beyond 500 results only the first 500 are shown, with a notice; empty
  results explain why

Inbound batches and stocktake

- Every stock-in creates an auto-numbered inbound batch; part detail keeps
  an in/out ledger
- A stock-in accepts a note; the part form no longer takes a stock figure -
  stock only comes from stock-ins
- Part detail lists stock per batch, only batches with remaining stock at
  the top level while exhausted batches collapse into a nested list;
  stocktake works per batch

BOM management

- BOM details render as a product / category / part tree; quantity, use
  mode, loss rate and the replaceable flag edit in place
- Switching products clears the table immediately and the choice is
  remembered; parts are no longer created from this screen - use part
  management

Other

- Refused part deletion explains which production records reference it
  instead of a bare error
- The exe file properties now carry the real version, in step with the app
- The database schema upgrades automatically on first launch, with an
  automatic backup beforehand; no manual steps

RFERP v2.0.1

== 中文 ==

修复 2.0.0 发布后在实际使用中发现的问题。

一、账号与会话

- 停用或删除账号后，该账号已登录的会话与「记住登录」立即失效，不再等空闲超时
- 修改角色时，同一表单里改过的显示名与状态不再被丢弃

二、批次与追溯

- 没有 BOM 的产品也能正常完成批次；此前界面会报错，状态也改不动
- 批次追溯新增「双向查询」：可按产品批次查用料来源，也可按零件编码反查用过它的批次

三、备份与恢复

- SQLite 整库恢复前会先校验快照文件；恢复后会明确要求退出并重新打开程序，
  期间不再接受业务操作，并提供一个退出入口
- 恢复提示按备份文件的实际内容区分 SQLite 与 MySQL，不再错误承诺「账号保持现状」

四、界面

- 统计排名的长名称会截断显示，悬停可看全名，不再压到条形图与数量列上

五、构建与安全

- 改用 Go 1.26.10 构建。2.0.0 由 go1.26.5 构建，其标准库内含 10 个已修复的安全问题，
  且标准库是编入 exe 的，用户升级系统也无法替换；重编后源码与二进制扫描均为 0
- 升级 edwards25519 到 v1.1.1，修复 GO-2026-4503

== English ==

Fixes for problems found in 2.0.0 after release.

Accounts and sessions

- Disabling or deleting an account now revokes its live sessions and remembered login
  immediately instead of waiting for the idle timeout
- Editing a role no longer discards display-name and status edits made in the same form

Batches and traceability

- A product without a BOM can complete its batch again; the screen used to throw and the
  status stayed unchanged
- Traceability gained a bidirectional query: material sources by product batch, or every
  batch that used a part code

Backup and restore

- SQLite restore validates the snapshot first, then states clearly that you must quit and
  reopen the program; business operations are refused until you do, and an exit action is
  offered
- Restore warnings distinguish SQLite from MySQL by the file's actual content and no longer
  promise that accounts are preserved when they are not

Interface

- Long names in the statistics rankings are truncated with the full name on hover, instead
  of overlapping the bar and quantity columns

Build and security

- Built with Go 1.26.10. 2.0.0 was built with go1.26.5, whose standard library carried ten
  fixed advisories, and the standard library is compiled into the exe, so a system update
  cannot replace it; source and binary scans are now clean
- edwards25519 upgraded to v1.1.1 (GO-2026-4503)

RFERP v2.0.0

== 中文 ==

一、界面全面重做

- 整个界面换了新的实现：统一侧栏导航、页面内分栏、表格与表单布局重新设计
- 业务功能保持完整：工作台、统计、操作记录、产品、零件、BOM、批次追溯、库存流水、
  用户与权限、备份与恢复、设置与帮助
- 设置页合并了「使用指南」「常见问题」「更新说明」，在主内容区显示，不另开窗口

二、库存提醒更清楚

- 零件页的库存提醒分两档：**零库存**显示红色「无库存」，**低于预警值**显示橙色「低库存」
- 零件列表的勾选框文字也相应改为「库存预警」

三、更新过程更可控

- 发现新版本时，在窗口内弹出更新说明（不再是系统对话框），可以直接看到这个版本改了什么
- 下载过程中显示进度；下载或安装失败可以直接重试，不用关掉程序再手动点一遍
- 更新包在运行安装程序前会先校验签名，校验不通过时拒绝执行并提示改用下载页

四、更新失败可以退回上一版本

- 如果新版本启动失败（配置损坏、数据库连不上、界面无法显示），下一次启动会询问是否回到
  更新前的版本；选「是」即自动换回，无需手工找安装目录
- 只有界面真正显示出来才算这一版正常；界面出不来时不会把更新当成成功
- 从 1.3.0 升级上来同样适用：升级后的第一次启动若失败，也能退回去

五、缺少运行组件时自动引导

- 程序需要 Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时。Windows 11 与带 Edge 的 Windows 10 已预装
- 如果机器上没有，程序会在启动时询问并自动下载安装（会弹一次系统权限确认），装好后继续
  启动，不需要重启；安装失败可重试，也可以选择用浏览器打开下载页手动安装

六、其他

- 配置文件、数据库与已有数据全部沿用，**升级后无需重新配置**
- 备份目录按类型分到 `manual\`（手动）、`auto\`（定期）、`safety\`（升级前自动快照），
  并写一份 `layout-migration.log`；旧备份不会丢失
- 已知限制：退回 1.3.0 后，旧版只能看到 `备份\` 根目录，看不到新的三个子目录

== English ==

A new interface

- The interface has been rebuilt: one sidebar for navigation, in-page sections, and
  redesigned tables and forms
- Every feature is still there: dashboard, statistics, audit log, products, parts,
  BOM, batch traceability, stock movements, users and permissions, backup and
  restore, settings and help
- Settings now hosts the guide, the FAQ and the changelog, shown in the main area
  rather than a separate window

Clearer stock alerts

- Parts now show two levels: **zero stock** in red ("no stock") and **below the
  warning level** in orange ("low stock")
- The column toggle on the parts list is labelled "stock warning" to match

A more controllable update

- When a new version is found it is announced in a window, with the release notes
  for that version, instead of a system dialog
- Download progress is shown, and a failed download or install can be retried
  without closing and reopening the program
- The installer is signature-checked before it runs; a failed check refuses to
  execute and points to the download page

Updates can roll back

- If a new version fails to start (broken configuration, unreachable database, no
  visible interface), the next launch offers to return to the previous version.
  Answering yes swaps it back automatically - no hunting through the install
  directory
- A version only counts as healthy once its interface actually renders. A build
  whose interface never appears is not treated as a successful update
- This applies to upgrades from 1.3.0 as well: if the first launch after upgrading
  fails, you can still go back

Missing runtime is handled

- The program needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime. Windows 11 and Windows 10
  with Edge already have it
- If it is missing, RFERP offers to download and install it at startup (one system
  permission prompt), then continues without a restart. A failed install can be
  retried, or you can open the download page and install it manually

Other

- Configuration, database and existing data are reused: **no re-setup after
  upgrading**
- Backups are now grouped into `manual\`, `auto\` and `safety\` (the last one is a
  snapshot taken before an upgrade), with a `layout-migration.log`. Existing
  backups are kept
- Known limitation: if you later go back to 1.3.0, the old version only sees the
  `备份\` root and not the three subdirectories

RFERP v1.3.0

== 中文 ==

一、新功能

- 侧栏左下角新增「设置」入口。点击后在右侧主内容区显示，不弹新窗口，方便对照当前业务页面查阅
  - 「使用指南」：随程序内置，断网也能读；顶部显示当前版本与内置最新版本，并可手动「查询最新更新」
  - 「常见问题」：按症状查阅，已从使用指南末尾独立出来
  - 「更新说明」：可点选查看每个历史版本的变更内容，当前收录 1.0.0 至 1.2.2 共 5 个版本
  - 发布脚本会在每次发版时自动累积更新说明，不必再手工维护

二、问题修复

- 修复：MySQL 的 .sql 导入此前只追加 INSERT、从不删除，恢复整份备份必然失败；现在 MySQL 与 SQLite 都是整库恢复（清空业务表后在同一事务内回灌），不再合并
  - 只恢复数据。备份中的建表与会话语句仍被忽略，不会改动现有表结构
  - users / schema_migrations / db_identity 会保留，其在备份中的记录被跳过
    —— 账号不参与回滚，否则恢复到只剩唯一账号之前的备份会导致无法登录
  - 恢复与清空都会先生成安全副本（pre_restore_ / pre_clear_），副本失败即中止；每类保留最新 5 份
  - 恢复界面有四道确认：备份文件校验、需手动输入的时间戳令牌、说明后果的确认框、执行中禁用按钮
- 修复：恢复结果现在区分「已回滚」「结果不确定」「已应用但收尾失败」，并各自给出下一步建议；SQLite 的安全副本清理按存储类型分别处理
- 修复：拒绝带库名限定的转储目标，避免恢复到错误的库
- 修复：本机 MySQL 未运行时改为通过服务控制管理器启动，权限不足时只把这一条操作提权；提权时显示的是「RFERP」而不是「net 命令」
  - 改用服务控制管理器 API 后，「拒绝访问。」不再因中文 Windows 的 GBK 控制台编码而显示为乱码
  - 已配置好的程序不再被退回首次配置向导，改为显示「数据库不可用」界面并给出重试 / 启动 MySQL / 退出
- 修复：在列表页（产品 / 零件 / BOM / 批次 / 用户）点选靠下的行时，列表会突然跳回顶部
- 修复：已撤销的批次不再计入出库统计

三、其他

- 文档：明确区分 SQLite 与 MySQL 的恢复语义（整库回退 vs 仅恢复数据）
- 文档：README 中明确许可证立场（保留所有权利）
- 已安装 1.2.2 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级，无需重新安装
- 数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Features

- A new "设置" (Settings) entry at the bottom of the sidebar. It replaces the main
  content area rather than opening a window, so you can read it beside the page
  you are checking
  - "使用指南" (Guide): ships inside the program and stays readable offline;
    shows the current and built-in latest version, with a manual
    "查询最新更新" (check for updates)
  - "常见问题" (FAQ): symptom-first lookup, split out of the end of the guide
  - "更新说明" (Changelog): per-version release notes you can pick from a list,
    currently covering the five releases from 1.0.0 to 1.2.2
  - The release script now accumulates the in-app changelog automatically

Fixes

- Restoring a MySQL .sql backup replayed only INSERT statements and never deleted
  anything, so restoring a full backup could not succeed. Restore is now a
  whole-database restore on both backends: the business tables are cleared and
  repopulated from the backup in a single transaction, and nothing is merged
  - Only data is restored. DDL and session statements in the dump are still
    ignored, so the live schema is never modified
  - users / schema_migrations / db_identity are preserved and their rows in the
    dump are skipped. Accounts are deliberately not rolled back: restoring a
    backup that predates your only account would leave a database you cannot log
    into
  - Restore and clear each take a safety copy first (pre_restore_ / pre_clear_)
    and abort if that copy fails; the five most recent of each kind are kept
  - Restoring is guarded by four gates: a verified backup file, a token you type
    in yourself, a confirmation that spells out the consequences, and disabled
    buttons while it runs
- Restore outcomes are now distinguished — rolled back, uncertain, and applied
  but failed to finalise — each with its own recommended next step. SQLite safety
  copies are now pruned per storage backend
- Dumps that qualify tables with a schema name are rejected instead of restoring
  into the wrong database
- When the local MySQL service is not running it is now started through the
  service control manager, elevating only that one operation if permissions
  require it. The UAC prompt now names "RFERP" rather than "net command"
  - Switching to the service control manager API also fixes messages such as
    "拒绝访问。" being shown as mojibake, because the console code page on a
    Chinese Windows is GBK
  - A configured install is no longer sent back into the first-run setup wizard.
    It gets a "数据库不可用" screen with retry / start MySQL / quit
- Selecting a row near the bottom of a list (products / parts / BOM / batches /
  users) no longer scrolls the list back to the top
- Revoked batches are no longer counted in outbound stock statistics

Other

- Docs: the different restore semantics of SQLite and MySQL are now stated
  separately
- Docs: the licensing position (all rights reserved) is now explicit in the README
- Note: the list fix works by the table no longer taking keyboard focus, so the
  arrow keys no longer move the selection between rows. Mouse selection is
  unchanged.
- Users already on 1.2.2 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.2

== 中文 ==

一、问题修复

- 修复：打开「操作记录」会导致程序直接退出（闪退）；现在可以正常打开与查看
- 修复：数据库升级前会先自动备份，且备份失败就不再继续升级
  · MySQL：升级前生成并校验一份 .sql 备份（保存到备份目录）
  · SQLite：升级前生成并校验一份 .db 快照
  · 备份失败时中止升级，避免出现「升级到一半」的库
  · 全新空库初始化不会产生多余备份

二、其他

- 已安装 1.2.1 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级，无需重新安装
- 数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Fixes

- Opening the operation log no longer crashes the app; the page opens normally
- A database upgrade now takes a verified pre-upgrade backup first, and does not
  proceed if that backup fails
  - MySQL: a .sql dump is written and verified before the upgrade
  - SQLite: a .db snapshot is created and verified before the upgrade
  - If the backup fails the upgrade is aborted, so a database can no longer be
    left half-upgraded
  - A fresh empty database is still initialised without an extra backup

Other

- Users already on 1.2.1 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.1

== 中文 ==

一、问题修复

- 修复：在列表页（产品 / 零件 / BOM / 批次 / 用户）点选靠下的行时，列表会突然跳回顶部；
  现在点选不再改变滚动位置
  （原因：清选中态时用到了一个会连带滚动的底层调用，已改为只清选中、不滚动）

二、其他

- 已安装 1.2.0 的用户可直接通过内置「自动更新」升级到本版本，无需重新安装
- 本版本不含新功能；数据与配置无需任何手工处理

== English ==

Fixes

- Selecting a row near the bottom of a list (products / parts / BOM / batches / users)
  no longer scrolls the list back to the top; the scroll position is now preserved
  (the selection was being cleared with a lower-level call that also scrolled, and it
  now clears without scrolling)

Other

- Users already on 1.2.0 can update in place through the built-in auto-update;
  no reinstall is needed
- No new features; no manual data or configuration step is required

RFERP v1.2.0

== 中文 ==

一、重点更新

1. 新增本地 SQLite 存储（单机零安装）
- 首次运行向导新增「存储方式」选择：MySQL（多人/高级）或 SQLite（单机零安装）
- SQLite 模式下整个数据库就是数据目录下的一个文件 rferp.db，完全不需要安装 MySQL
- 旧配置（没有 storage 字段）继续使用 MySQL，程序不会静默切换
- 备份/恢复与存储类型绑定：MySQL 用 .sql（导入时仅追加 INSERT，不覆盖已有数据），
  SQLite 用整库 .db 快照（整库回退，完成后自动重启应用）
- 两种备份不可混用，跨类型恢复会被明确拒绝并给出提示

2. 新增产品 / 零件可搜索选择器
- BOM 页与产品 / 零件列表页新增「输入即筛选」下拉，按编码 / 名称 / 规格匹配
- BOM 页的「产品 → 零件 → 用量」级联与查询框双向同步，用哪边选都得到一致结果
- 产品 / 零件列表支持本地即时筛选，不再重新查询数据库

3. 表格列宽自适应
- 产品、BOM、批次、用户、看板等表格按内容自动调整列宽，超长内容以省略号截断，
  不再出现文字被挤压或列宽与内容不匹配

二、功能改进

- 库存与审计写入改为同一事务：批次状态流转与库存扣减、审计日志与业务写入，
  不再可能只成功一半
- 数量校验更严格：拒绝负数 / 零等非法值，金额统一按 2 位小数量化
- CSV 导出失败会明确报错（不再静默），并在失败时清理临时文件
- 登录与首次创建管理员更稳健：用户数查询异常时正常显示登录窗（不再误入「创建管理员」）；
  遇到「已初始化」自动切换到登录窗

三、问题修复

- 批次状态变更与库存扣减改为原子操作（此前中途失败可能造成库存与状态不一致）
- 审计日志与业务写入改为原子操作
- 拒绝非法的库存数量（负数 / 零）
- 库存审计数值统一量化，避免浮点小数残留
- CSV 导出错误会向上抛出，失败时删除临时文件
- 会话级数据库设置（外键 / 唯一性检查）固定在同一连接，不再跨连接串用

四、其他

- SQLite 恢复前会自动把当前数据库另存为 rferp.db.before-restore-<时间戳>，
  并清理陈旧的 WAL/SHM 文件
- 存储方式仅在「首次运行向导」中选择；从 1.1.0 升级的已有安装继续使用 MySQL
- 数据库结构升级到 v13（新增内部标识表，用于数据库身份校验）；程序自动迁移，无需手工操作
- 构建工具链：Go 1.22 → Go 1.26（发布使用 go1.26.5）；
  SQLite 采用纯 Go 驱动（modernc.org/sqlite，无 CGO，无需额外运行库）
- 工程与流程：新增 PR 校验工作流（Windows / Go verify）、PR 模板、
  按标签分组的自动发布说明、CONTRIBUTING.md；主分支规则集归档到 docs/rulesets/
- 内部重构：抽出用例接口与仓储接口，为后续扩展铺路；补充了大量单元与集成测试

== English ==

Highlights

1. Local SQLite storage (single machine, zero install)
- The first-run wizard now offers a storage choice: MySQL (multi-user / advanced)
  or SQLite (single machine, zero install)
- With SQLite the whole database is one file, rferp.db in your data directory,
  and MySQL is not needed at all
- Existing configs (no "storage" key) keep using MySQL; nothing switches silently
- Backup and restore follow the storage: MySQL uses .sql (importing only appends
  INSERTs and never overwrites existing data), SQLite uses whole-file .db snapshots
  (full rollback, then the app restarts automatically)
- The two kinds are not interchangeable; a cross-kind restore is refused with a
  clear message

2. Searchable product / part picker
- BOM and product / part list pages gained a type-to-filter dropdown matching
  code, name and spec
- On the BOM page the product -> part -> usage cascade and the search box stay in
  sync both ways, so either way of choosing gives the same result
- Product and part lists can be filtered instantly without re-querying the database

3. Tables fit their content
- Product, BOM, batch, user and dashboard tables size their columns to the content
  and truncate anything too long with an ellipsis, so text is no longer squeezed
  and column widths match what they hold

Improvements

- Inventory and audit writes now share one transaction: a batch status change plus
  its stock deduction, and an audit entry plus its business write, can no longer
  half-commit
- Quantity validation is stricter: negative or zero values are rejected, and amounts
  are consistently rounded to two decimals
- CSV export failures are reported instead of being swallowed, and temporary files
  are cleaned up
- Login and first-run admin creation are more robust: a failed user-count query shows
  the login window instead of the "create admin" window, and an already-initialized
  server switches to login automatically

Fixes

- Batch status changes and stock deductions are now atomic (a failure in between
  could leave stock and status out of step)
- Audit entries and their business writes are now atomic
- Invalid inventory quantities (negative / zero) are rejected
- Stock audit values are quantized, avoiding floating-point leftovers in the log
- CSV export errors are propagated, and the temp file is removed on failure
- Session-level database settings (foreign-key / unique checks) stay on one connection
  instead of leaking across the pool

Other

- A SQLite restore first keeps your current database as rferp.db.before-restore-<timestamp>
  and clears stale WAL/SHM files
- The storage choice is offered only by the first-run wizard; installations upgraded
  from 1.1.0 keep using MySQL
- Schema upgraded to v13 (an internal identity table used for database identity checks);
  the app migrates automatically, no manual step needed
- Toolchain: Go 1.22 -> Go 1.26 (releases built with go1.26.5); SQLite uses a pure-Go
  driver (modernc.org/sqlite, no CGO, no extra runtime)
- Engineering: PR verification workflow (Windows / Go verify), PR template, automatic
  release notes grouped by label, CONTRIBUTING.md, branch rulesets archived under
  docs/rulesets/
- Internal refactor: use-case and repository interfaces extracted to prepare for future
  extensions; substantially more unit and integration tests
